mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_distributed_lock (lock_key, holder, lock_time, expire_time, version) VALUES (#{lockKey}, #{holder}, #{lockTime}, #{expireTime}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE t_distributed_lock SET holder = #{holder}, lock_time = #{lockTime}, expire_time = #{expireTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE lock_key = #{lockKey} AND (expire_time <= #{now} OR holder = #{holder})
mapper.select: SELECT holder FROM t_distributed_lock WHERE lock_key = #{lockKey}
